ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels; the ventral surface appears approximately 98% dark with minimal light-reflectance except for water droplets.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface; absence of macro-level mottling or large geometric white blobs; localized high-intensity pixel clusters are confined to linear scratches on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an obtuse internal angle and a moderate vertical pixel depth relative to the horizontal width of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged serration pattern consisting of irregular peaks and narrow valleys along the entirety of both trailing edges; higher amplitude peaks are visible on the inner regions near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep with the lower margin showing a smooth convex curve that transitions into a sharp, upward-pointing distal tip (horn) on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four parallel, high-contrast light-colored linear marks (rake marks) situated on the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe, oriented approximately 45 degrees relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake marks on the right fluke lobe; irregular deep indentations on the trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting minor past trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly pronounced and elongated upward-pointing distal tips at the extremities of both lobes.
